description: Turn any image into custom stickers and labels printed by Bottle Your Brand.

interface.longDescription:
Turn any image into printed custom stickers or labels. Design something in ChatGPT, or drop in a photo or logo, and get a link to order with your print-ready artwork already attached.

Make die-cut vinyl stickers cut to the shape of your art (2" to 6", 20-piece minimum), wine labels (3.5" × 4"), beer labels (4" × 3.5"), water bottle labels (8.25" × 1.75" or 8" × 2.125"), dropper bottle labels (3" × 2"), and all-purpose square and rectangle labels from 2" to 6" for jars, candles, boxes, packaging and more.

Your art is sized to its exact print size with bleed at 300 dpi, so an image straight from ChatGPT is ready to print. See your wine, beer, water or dropper bottle label on a real bottle before you order, so there's no guessing what the final product will look like, plus a print preview showing exactly where the cut lines are and the safe zone for text. Low resolution or text too close to the edge gets flagged before you order. Think of it as your design and print assistant for custom stickers and labels.

Stickers are printed on 7 mil, high-gloss, UV-coated vinyl that's waterproof, dishwasher safe and rated for 5 years outdoors. Labels are printed on 7 mil matte stock that's waterproof, with an easy crack-and-peel backing for quick application.

Ask anything about printing while you're at it: what size fits a water bottle or a jar, whether your file is sharp enough, or how to remove a background so a sticker cuts to shape.

Try asking: "Make stickers of my dog from this picture." "Turn our logo into 3 inch square labels for candle jars." "Design a beer label for my homebrew IPA and show it on a bottle." "I need 4x2 rectangle labels for my product boxes." "Give me a template for a dropper bottle label so I can design it in Canva."
